fromContent: The interior angles of any planar triangle sum to exactly 180 degrees.
toContent: In Euclidean geometry, through a point not on a given line there is exactly one line parallel to it (the parallel postulate).

fromContent: A satellite in a higher circular orbit moves at a lower orbital speed than one in a lower circular orbit.
toContent: For a circular orbit, gravity supplies the centripetal force, giving orbital speed v = sqrt(GM/r), which decreases as the radius r grows.

fromContent: People who carry one copy of the sickle-cell allele have increased resistance to malaria.
toContent: The sickle haemoglobin variant distorts red blood cells under low oxygen, disrupting the Plasmodium parasite's life cycle inside the cell.

fromContent: A binding price ceiling set below the market equilibrium price produces a shortage of the good.
toContent: At any price below equilibrium, the quantity consumers demand exceeds the quantity producers supply.

fromContent: Binary search requires its input array to be sorted in order to work correctly.
toContent: Binary search repeatedly halves the search interval, discarding the half that cannot contain the target by comparing it with the midpoint element.

fromContent: Solid ice floats on top of liquid water.
toContent: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonding holds its molecules in an open crystalline lattice.

fromContent: During a storm you see the lightning flash before you hear the thunder, even though they happen together.
toContent: Light travels roughly a million times faster than sound, so it reaches an observer almost instantly while sound is delayed.

fromContent: The sum of any two even integers is itself even.
toContent: An integer is even exactly when it can be written as 2k for some integer k.

fromContent: Daftari's birth mode gates its candidate-seeding on a recall@20 >= 0.70 kill condition, switching the embedding model if recall falls below that floor.
toContent: Birth mode seeds candidate edges by retrieving a document's top-K embedding neighbours via vault_search_related.

fromContent: Retrieval-augmented generation acts as a regularizer on the retrieval inverse problem, injecting a low-rank prior that suppresses the unconstrained components that surface as hallucinations.
toContent: Regularizing an ill-posed inverse problem works by adding a prior that restricts the solution to a lower-dimensional subspace, damping the components the data alone cannot determine.

fromContent: GPS satellites apply a continuous relativistic correction to their onboard atomic clocks to stay synchronized with ground receivers.
toContent: Clocks at higher gravitational potential and in relative motion tick at measurably different rates, as predicted by general and special relativity.

fromContent: Overuse of antibiotics accelerates the emergence and spread of resistant bacterial strains.
toContent: Antibiotics impose a selection pressure under which rare resistant mutants survive and reproduce preferentially over susceptible bacteria.

fromContent: A hash table provides average-case constant-time O(1) lookups.
toContent: A good hash function spreads keys roughly uniformly across buckets, so the expected number of keys colliding in any one bucket stays constant as the table grows.

fromContent: There is no largest prime number; the primes are infinite.
toContent: Given any finite list of primes, multiplying them all together and adding one yields a number whose prime factors are none of those on the list.

fromContent: Deleting Daftari's .daftari/index.db file loses no vault data.
toContent: The index.db is a rebuildable projection of the markdown files, which are the single source of truth for all vault content and metadata.

fromContent: Fiat money holds its value even though it is not backed by gold or any other commodity.
toContent: Money's value rests on collective acceptance and legal-tender status, not on any intrinsic commodity backing.

fromContent: At an empty cold start, every Daftari curation action stages for human approval rather than auto-writing.
toContent: At cold start the action ledger is empty and every edge is a k=0 candidate, so the trust budget sits at its floor and no action can clear the auto-write gate.

fromContent: The noble gases are largely chemically inert and rarely form compounds.
toContent: Noble gases have a full valence electron shell, leaving little tendency to gain, lose, or share electrons.

fromContent: A feather and a hammer released together on the Moon strike the ground at the same instant.
toContent: With no air resistance, all objects fall with the same gravitational acceleration regardless of their mass.

fromContent: Git can detect whether the contents of a committed file have been altered after the fact.
toContent: Git names every stored object by a cryptographic hash of its contents, so any change to the contents produces a different object hash.

fromContent: The sample mean is an unbiased estimator of the population mean.
toContent: The expected value of the sample mean equals the population mean exactly, E[X-bar] = mu.

fromContent: Mature mammalian red blood cells cannot divide or repair their own DNA.
toContent: During development, mature mammalian red blood cells expel their nucleus, losing the DNA that division and repair would require.
